node.title: Node.js versions below 20 are outside the current frontend baseline
node.summary: Move to an active or maintenance LTS line before attempting framework upgrades.
notes: Production applications should use Active LTS or Maintenance LTS release lines.
Validate local build scripts, CI images, and native addons when moving Node majors.

react.title: React 19 requires the modern JSX transform
react.summary: Projects upgrading to React 19 should validate JSX transform settings and related tooling.
notes: If using TypeScript, upgrade @types/react and @types/react-dom with the React major.
Run codemods for React 19 migration where possible.
affectedPatterns: Libraries that depend on React internals
suggestedActions: Upgrade `react` and `react-dom` together and align type packages in the same PR.
Run React 19 codemods before hand-editing legacy entrypoints or refs.

react-dom.title: React DOM upgrade should be reviewed alongside app bootstrap APIs
react-dom.summary: Check client bootstrap points and hydration entry files when moving to React 19.
notes: Search for legacy render and hydrate entrypoints before upgrading.
Confirm SSR and hydration code paths behave correctly after the upgrade.

patternGuidance.migration: Review hydration bootstrap code to ensure it uses the React 19 entrypoint shape and root options correctly.
Verify bootstrap code imports `createRoot` from `react-dom/client` and that only one root is created per container.

suggestedActions: Search app bootstrap and hydration entry files first.
Validate SSR hydration flows after replacing legacy entry APIs.

next.title: Next.js 15 introduces async request APIs
next.summary: Previously synchronous request-bound APIs become asynchronous and may require code changes.
notes: Review uses of cookies, headers, and draftMode in server code.
Review page, layout, route, and metadata functions that access params or searchParams.
React 19 becomes the minimum supported React version.

patternGuidance.migration: In server code, change `const store = cookies()` to `const store = await cookies()` and make the surrounding function async.
In server code, change `const headerList = headers()` to `const headerList = await headers()` and make the surrounding function async.
Change `draftMode()` access to `await draftMode()` and update the caller to async.
For `page`, `layout`, route handlers, and metadata APIs, migrate synchronous `params` access to the async request API shape or generated helper types.
For `page` and related entrypoints, migrate synchronous `searchParams` access to the async request API shape.
Prefer `useActionState` during the Next 15 + React 19 migration instead of adding new `useFormState` usage.

suggestedActions: Run the `@next/codemod` upgrade flow before manual cleanup.
Search for `@next-codemod-error` markers after codemods to find unresolved callsites.

vite.title: Vite 7 drops Node.js 18 support
vite.summary: Upgrade Node.js before or alongside Vite when targeting Vite 7.
notes: Review browser target defaults if your support matrix includes older browsers.

patternGuidance.migration: Update `engines.node` and CI/runtime images so they satisfy Vite 7's Node 20.19+ or 22.12+ requirement.
Recheck `build.target` against your browser support matrix because newer defaults may shift output expectations.

suggestedActions: Upgrade Node before or with Vite 7.
Re-run production build checks after adjusting browser targets.
